scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend "npm run test:watch -w frontend" "npm run test:watch -w backend"
